resources.string:
Tap the screen to adjust brightness, color, and the auto-stop timer.

The clock updates and shifts slightly every minute. The screen stays on; pressing the power button turns it off normally. The app will not turn it back on automatically.

Battery use needs testing on your phone. Shifting cannot completely prevent OLED burn-in.
Clock brightness, one to thirty percent
Cycle text color: gray / warm / green

Schedules can cross midnight, such as 23:00 to 07:00 the next day. Flip animations are disabled; the time, date, and battery level continue to update and shift together each minute. Regular settings resume afterward. Move the night brightness slider fully left for the device minimum. Actual power savings need testing.
Start and end times must be different
Auto-stop: less than 1 min remaining\nEnds at %1$s
Night brightness, device minimum to ten percent
Uses night brightness and the selected text color, without flip animations.
Uses night brightness with darker text, without flip animations.
